Name: The Hedgewitchs Almanac
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[b][u][size=6]The Hedgewitch's Almanac version 0.70.3[/size][/u][/b]

[b][u][size=5]🌿 Welcome to The Hedgewitch's Almanac! [/size][/u][/b]🌿
A cozy witchcraft and herbalism expansion for Stardew Valley, made with love by Nesryn Astra Rose. 🧙‍♀️ Grow and forage magical herbs 🌱, cook at your very own witch's hearth 🍲, brew remedies 🧪, ride a broom 🧹, draw tarot 🃏 and adventure with a tiny familiar at your side 🐸. Everything is waiting to be discovered at your own pace, and the in-game Almanac 📖 and Cookbook explain it all.
Current release: [b]0.70.3[/b] ✨ (with Hedgewitch's Broom 1.73.7). New herbs, recipes, familiars and little bits of magic arrive in regular updates! 🌙
[b][u][size=4]🌱 Herbs, flowers and crops[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🌿 [b]17 crops[/b], all redrawn in a cottagecore style with a sprinkle of dark magic.[/*]
[*]🌷 [b]Spring:[/b] Moonmint, Comfrey, Starbell. ☀️ [b]Summer:[/b] Sunpetal, Foxglow. 🍂 [b]Fall:[/b] Witchroot, Yarrow, Duskrose. 🌙 [b]All year:[/b] Hearthsage, Moonbell, Mossheart. ❄️ [b]Winter:[/b] Rimeleaf, Yulewort, Frostember, Snowbloom Barley, Winterpear Vine, Candlenut Root.[/*]
[*]🛍️ Seeds at Pierre's, plus Seed Bags (six seeds for four times the price).[/*]
[*]🍄 [b]Wild gathering[/b] across the Valley, with rare finds tied to weather and place: Tideglass Bloom on rainy summer beaches 🌧️ and Rainmoss in the rainy Secret Woods.[/*]
[*]📈 [b]Herbalism levels:[/b] earn XP for gathering and brewing. Levels 2 to 5 add bonus yields, gold-quality remedies and new recipes.[/*]
[*]🌾 [b]Herb Drying Rack (400g):[/b] dry a fresh herb into a Dried Herb Bundle in two days.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🍲 Witch's Hearth Stove and Cookbook[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🔥 [b]Witch's Hearth Stove (900g at Pierre's):[/b] one cozy cast-iron stove for everything you bake, cook or brew, with a bubbling cauldron and a friendly flame. It replaces the old Hearthstone Oven and Apothecary Brewing Station, and old ones in your world convert automatically.[/*]
[*]🍞 [b]Breads, pies and cottage foods[/b], 🍰 [b]12 herb dishes[/b] that unlock as your Herbalism level rises, and 🧪 [b]remedies, teas and elixirs[/b], each with its own buff.[/*]
[*]📕 [b]Witch's Cookbook (150g at Pierre's):[/b] every recipe in one rose-pink book. New players get one in the welcome letter, and existing saves get a free copy by mail.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🔮 Divination and magic[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🃏 [b]Valley Tarot (250g):[/b] draw one of ten cards a day for a helpful or challenging buff. The Wheel of Fortune and The Empty Purse change Pierre's prices by 10% for the day.[/*]
[*]💘 [b]Valley Oracle (Pierre):[/b] one draw a day names today's romantic match among the romanceable villagers in your game, plus one of 12 specialty cards with a day-long effect.[/*]
[*]🔮 [b]Crystal Ball, Seer's Table, Tarot and Oracle Table:[/b] check the weather, summon rain ☔, pass a little time, or give villagers readings for gold.[/*]
[*]🕯️ [b]Blessing Candle, Moon Altar, Moon Jar, Dewdrop Wand and Witch's Cauldron:[/b] a whole set of spell and potion furniture.[/*]
[*]💎 [b]Ores and crystals:[/b] glowing gem nodes in the Mines, crystal candles, charm rings and a Crystal Table.[/*]
[*]🌙 [b]Moon Phases:[/b] a daily buff from the 28-day moon cycle. ✉️ [b]Wax-Sealed Letters[/b] are a gift every villager likes, and 🫙 [b]Moon-Kissed Bottles[/b] give moon water for your crops.[/*]
[*]🪶 [b]Village Witch Standing:[/b] a ten-level reputation track with small perks, ending in the Wren's Road quest for the Travelling Witch outfit.[/*]
[*]🛋️ [b]Robin's witchy decor:[/b] wallpapers, purple floors, wall and floor pieces and a Tabletop Crystal Ball.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🧹 Brooms and 🐸 familiars[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]🧹 [b]Four fully animated brooms:[/b] Frogbloom, Lantern, Stardust Comet and the Moonlit Archwitch Broom, with three upgrades and an Enchanted Broom Stand.[/*]
[*]🐸 [b]Five familiars:[/b] Marshlight the frog (a hat!), Moonquill the raven, Hushwing the ghost owl, Sootpaw the black cat and Mossback the toad. Each has its own bond, memories and Field Journal page.[/*]
[/list]🕯️ Candles, loom, tower and garden
[list]
[*]🕯️ [b]Chandler's Bench candles[/b], 🧶 [b]Weaver's Loom[/b] and 🏺 [b]Potter's Wheel[/b] crafts.[/*]
[*]🗼 [b]Witch Tower:[/b] a free, vine-wrapped stone tower from Robin that changes with the seasons.[/*]
[*]🌿 [b]Living Hedgerows[/b], 🍄 [b]Fairy Rings[/b], scarecrows, lanterns, walkways, fences and gates, and the hidden 🚪 [b]Witch's Room[/b].[/*]
[*]📜 [b]Villager appointments, Herbal Goods and Hedgewitch Orders[/b], the 📖 [b]Spell Book[/b] and Spell Jars, and an illustrated guidebook and Field Journal that tracks your progress.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🎉ONE reimagined festival[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]🎄 Yule (winter 25): the Feast of the Winter Star becomes the Yule Party, with a Sun Wheel wreath, moon arch, lantern staffs, a bonfire, rune stones and feast tables. Visit the Altar of the Old Ones once a day for a Goddess, God or rare Sun & Moon blessing, and keep a Hearth Altar at home. 🕯️[/size][/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]📋 Requirements[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]✅ SMAPI, Content Patcher and Parchment[/*]
[*]🧹 Hedgewitch's Broom is included in the same zip, no separate download.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]📥 Install or update[/size][/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and Parchment.[/*]
[*]Unzip into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. It contains TheHedgewitchsAlmanac and HedgewitchsBroom; keep both directly inside Mods.[/*]
[*]Updating? Replace both old folders with both new ones, and back up your saves. 💾[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI. New saves get a welcome letter 💌, and existing saves get a one-time catch-up letter for anything missing.[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]⚙️ Settings[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]RenameWinterFestival (Content Patcher config, default on): shows the winter 25 festival as the Yule Party. 🎄[/*]
[*]Hedgewitch's Broom config.json: reminders on or off, wreath position and chime. 🔔[/*]
[/list][b][u][size=4]🐛 Support[/size][/u][/b]
Something not showing up? Post your SMAPI log at smapi.io/log and say whether Parchment loaded. Compatibility with other food, texture or content mods is not guaranteed.
Created with 💜 by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b] 🌙
